rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: The Oddfellows Rose
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 2011).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2011 as 'The Oddfellows Rose'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink, purple shading. Moderate fragrance. Semi-double to double, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
